summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing daily ASX buyback notices under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program, covering Class A (NWSA) and Class B (NWS) shares. No price, share count, or completed transaction totals were stated; the disclosure merely satisfies Australian Securities Exchange daily reporting rules. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date is referenced. The program authorizes repurchases from time to time at management's discretion, subject to market conditions, securities laws, and alternative investment opportunities. Watch actual repurchase volumes and any acceleration of buybacks as signals of management's valuation view and capital-return posture.
